public_body: Boston Planning And Development Agency Board Of Directors
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to admit members of the public to fill vacant seats during the March 2, 2017 meeting; the other allegations were rejected or declined, and the Board was ordered to comply.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 2, 2017 meeting notice was not properly posted because City Hall was allegedly closed on March 1, making the notice inaccessible.
allegations.key_passage: the Board therefore successfully satisfied its notice posting obligations when the notice was published to that website

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board held the March 2, 2017 meeting in a room too small to accommodate the anticipated crowd.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board's regular meeting room was the largest space available at the time, the Board acted appropriately by holding its meeting there.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board let security personnel record the audience without the required announcement that the meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board made this clear at the outset, we conclude that the Board complied with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged members of the public were improperly removed from the meeting room by security personnel during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law therefore gives discretion to the chair to determine who may speak or otherwise participate at a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the Board removed people of color more readily than white audience members, which the complainants framed as racial discrimination.
allegations.key_passage: In any event, allegations of racial bias would not, in and of themselves, violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board improperly denied members of the public access by not admitting people waiting outside to fill seats vacated after removals.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board was plainly aware that members of the public sought to enter the meeting room, its failure to admit them violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board 'quickly and quietly' voted to adopt the JP/Rox plan, implying the vote was inaudible to those present.
allegations.key_passage: our review of the meeting video shows that the Board made this vote at sufficient volume and with sufficient clarity to make clear to the public what decision was being made.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
